diagram.manim_description: Plain white canvas (BG), 1920 by 1080 pixels. Draw two horizontal rows of flat five-pointed stars, one above the other, with the stars of the two rows standing in the same 12 columns. Every star points up, has an outer diameter of 80 px, a fill in its star colour and a 3 px INK outline. Column k (k = 1 to 12) has its centre at x = 166 + 100 x (k - 1) px (column 1 at x = 166, column 12 at x = 1266). Row 1 centre line is y = 440 px, row 2 centre line is y = 600 px. Row 1 colours from left to right: yellow, green, orange, blue, pink, grey, yellow, green, orange, blue, pink, grey. Row 2 colours from left to right: green, orange, yellow, blue, green, orange, yellow, blue, green, orange, yellow, blue. Star colour values: yellow #F4D41F, green #7BBF3A, orange #E8801E, blue #3C6DC5, pink #C768AE, grey #8C8C8C. After the 12th star of each row draw a bold ellipsis of three INK dots (radius 6 px, 20 px apart) centred at x = 1366 px on that row's centre line. The right part of the card stays empty; the solution diagram adds columns 13 to 16 there. Draw nothing else: no numbers, no rings, no boxes, no marks on any star.
must_not_show: any ring, box or mark on a star (nothing is solved)
stars beyond the 12th in either row
the words blue, meet, LCM or the cycle lengths 6 and 4
accuracy_checks: Row 1 colour of column k is item ((k-1) mod 6)+1 of yellow, green, orange, blue, pink, grey: blue stars only at columns 4 and 10
Row 2 colour of column k is item ((k-1) mod 4)+1 of green, orange, yellow, blue: blue stars only at columns 4, 8 and 12
Exactly 12 stars in each row (24 in all) and the two stars of a column share the same x
Nothing marks the answer (column 16 is not drawn)
